findings.title: Analytics average usage label truncates (Int(saturating:)) instead of using PercentText rounding
findings.evidence: 92.9 shows 92% here and 93% elsewhere (raised by Higia and Jano, remediation B18 r2)
findings.impact: Inconsistent percent between Analytics average and other labels
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B18 r2

findings.title: Pending crossings keyed only by threshold: a reset and re-cross while the first add() is in flight lets the stale completion act on the new crossing
findings.evidence: No generation token on pending entries (raised by Nemesis, remediation B18 r2)
findings.fix: Tag each pending crossing with a generation/token and ignore completions whose token no longer matches
findings.impact: Rare duplicate or dropped rollback within add() latency
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B18 r2

findings.title: notif_title_fmt uses %d for a 64-bit Int argument
findings.evidence: Value clamped to 0..1000 so harmless today; %ld is correct (raised by Nemesis, remediation B18 r2)
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B18 r2

findings.title: Tracker repeats per-key cleanup (drop empty pending; remove from three maps on reset and prune); clearKnownDenial also re-arms without saying so
findings.evidence: Raised by Higia, remediation B18 r2
findings.fix: Extract forget(key)/dropEmptyPending(key); rename clearKnownDenial to clearKnownDenialAndRearm
findings.impact: A future per-key map could be missed on one path
findings.origin: new_findings from review panel, remediation B18 r2
